title: Foundry item definition, version 1
description: Mirrors foundry.core.ItemDef. The Java parser is authoritative until a schema generated from it replaces this file; ItemSchemaTest (planned, task T2) must keep the two in step.

texture.description: Flat item texture; Foundry generates the model. Exclusive with model.

mechanics.description: See docs/MECHANICS.md. Each: trigger, optional conditions, actions, cooldown_ticks, chance.

tag.description: on_bolt_hit only: which launch_bolt this answers.

charge_ticks.description: on_use only: hold right click this long, then let go to fire, like drawing a bow. 0 fires at once.

attack_damage.description: Whole damage of a melee hit. 0 or absent keeps the base item's. A sword hits for about 7.

attack_speed.description: Swings per second, used with attack_damage. Defaults to a sword's 1.6.
